finalMessage:
Implemented shipping: free when the discounted subtotal is at least 100.00; otherwise 5.99. Shipping appears in the quote and charged total.

All tests and `ostf check --base main` pass.

- Impacted items: `R-CHECKOUT-ORDER`, `R-TAX-RATE`, new draft `R-SHIPPING`.
- Verified tests: `TestPlaceOrder`, `TestPlaceOrderShipping`, `TestPrice`, `TestTax`, including threshold and discount cases.
- Added links: `R-SHIPPING` refines `N-BUY`, implemented by `pricing.Price`, verified by `TestPlaceOrderShipping`.
